applies_to.quote: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Classification, Valuation, and Operation of Investment Portfolio) Third Amendment Directions, 2026

answer.action: Commercial banks must adopt the new valuation methodology for quoted and unquoted units of InvITs and REITs as specified.
answer.action_quote: Paragraph 84A shall be inserted as under

effective_date.quote: These Amendment Directions shall come into effect from the date of issue.

answer.amends: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Classification, Valuation, and Operation of Investment Portfolio) Directions, 2025
